init_FMBase: initialize an FMBase environment with a model path and target pose for reach tasks
get_obs_dict_FMBase: get the observation dictionary containing joint positions, velocities, and pose error from simulation
get_reward_dict_FMBase: compute the reward dictionary with reach distance, bonus, penalty, and dense reward values
reset_FMReachEnvFixed: reset the FMReachEnvFixed environment to its initial fixed joint position and velocity state
reset_FMReachEnvRandom: reset the FMReachEnvRandom environment with a random target pose within actuator control range
